name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-marisa-kirisame
title: Super Mario World Styled Marisa Kirisame
description:
She is from Touhou Project.
2 player's color is White Marisa(from Touhou 3 -Phantasmagoria of Dim.Dream.).
The zip includes:
GFX00.bin
GFX10.bin
GFX28.bin
GFX32.bin
Marisashared.pal(shared palette)

*This GFX00.bin is the same as Reimu's GFX.
Reimu's GFXs is here( https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=20662 )

Update: Fixed GFX10's her back view.

Moderator's note: modified GFX10 and included a palette file to fix Yoshi's colors on the Overworld. To use it, import with the Green Star + Red Arrow button on every submap.
